summary.title: Portfolio
summary.description: Selected personal and professional systems from backend engineering, transport platforms, digital goods, finance operations, and internal tools.

projects.name: Voicetyper
projects.brief: A minimalist voice typing tool and dictation service. Connects to robust speech-to-text APIs to provide fast, continuous typing directly into text editors and active windows.

projects.name: Pricing Backend
projects.brief: Flight pricing backend migration and modernization work at Agoda, focused on rewriting Scala services into Kotlin while keeping production pricing flows reliable.

projects.name: Pickup and Drop Off Aggregation Service
projects.brief: Transport service aggregation work for GoTo, supporting pickup and drop-off experiences across ride-hailing flows and related microservices.
projects.imageAlt: Pickup and drop off aggregation service preview

projects.name: Booking Management Services
projects.brief: Edit booking and cancel booking services for transport products, built to support changing product requirements while preserving existing operational reliability.

projects.name: GoTransit KRL Integration
projects.brief: Public transportation integration work connecting GoTransit with KRL train services and related transport platform capabilities.

projects.name: Historical Place and Trip Advisor Services
projects.brief: Location and trip-supporting backend services for transport experiences, including historical place and trip advisor capabilities.

projects.name: Digital Goods Platform
projects.brief: Maintained and evolved a large digital goods microservice platform across Grab and Kudo, covering bill payments, telco billing, and game voucher integrations.

projects.name: Kafka Bill Payment Integrations
projects.brief: Kafka-based integration services for bill payment providers such as PDAM, PLN, BPJS, Telkom, telco billers, and game voucher providers.

projects.name: Dynamic Reconciliation Engine
projects.brief: Internal finance tooling at Kudo for transaction reconciliation, margin fee calculation, and finance operations automation.

projects.name: Fraud Management System
projects.brief: Fraud operations system with Sift Science fraud analytics API integration through daemon-based processing.

projects.name: Enterprise C# Applications
projects.brief: C# application work covering HRIS migration, notification management with SignalR, video streaming APIs, investment application maintenance, jobs portal migration, and e-learning.
projects.imageAlt: Enterprise C sharp applications portfolio image

projects.name: SunFish HRIS Implementation
projects.brief: HRIS implementation and customization work for client business processes, covering modules such as employee data, attendance, payroll, reimbursement, loan, performance, training, organization, career administration, and recruitment.
